# IMPPAT Database Automated Scraper

A Python-based web scraping pipeline built to systematically extract, clean, and structure phytochemical data from the IMPPAT (Indian Medicinal Plants, Phytochemistry And Therapeutics) database.

**Note:** The dataset generated by this tool serves as the foundational data pipeline for my [Phytochemical Clustering & Disease Target Mapping](link-to-your-clustering-repo) project.

## 📊 Project Overview

| Overview | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| **What the Project Is** | An automated data engineering tool built to extract and structure phytochemical compound records from a specialized medicinal database into a unified, analysis-ready format. |
| **What It Does** | • Systematically navigates the IMPPAT web database to extract phytochemical records across various medicinal plants.<br>• Captures critical 2D/3D chemical identifiers including **SMILES**, **InChI**, **InChIKey**, and **DeepSMILES** strings.<br>• Cleans and compiles unstructured web data into a relational `.csv` format for downstream machine learning. |
| **Data Source** | The **IMPPAT database** (Indian Medicinal Plants, Phytochemistry And Therapeutics). |
| **Results & Insights** | Successfully automated the extraction of **~190,000 phytochemical records** (`imppat_all_plants.csv`).<br><br>💡 **Key Insight:** Transformed highly fragmented, web-based botanical data into a foundational dataset. This proves the ability to build end-to-end pipelines (Data Engineering → Machine Learning). |

## 📂 Output Format

The scraper successfully outputs a clean, relational CSV file containing the following structured features for nearly 190,000 records:

* `Selected plant from drop-down:` (Botanical source name)
* `Processed Phytochemical Name` (Standardized IMPPHY ID)
* `Plant part` (e.g., flower, root, leaf)
* `Phytochemical name` (Common chemical name)
* `SMILES` (Simplified Molecular-Input Line-Entry System)
* `InChI` (International Chemical Identifier)
* `InChIKey` (Hashed InChI)
* `DeepSMILES` (Optimized SMILES for machine learning)
* `References` (Source literature/ISBN)
